system.description:
Olganyar Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Very Rare, Fire. 1 item slot. Attunement. Uses: 4.

Prerequisites: Cooking General Talent

This pot smells lightly of sage and smoke. All items cooked in this pot taste slightly smoky and are infused of sage - regardless of ingredient type

Infused Flavors (Ceremony): The pot has four charges. When you use a cooking craft to create a craft, you may expend one charge. If you do, randomly select one craft ingredient used in the pot and roll 2D100 to determine a random special property. You may choose one of those to add to the craft ingredient while it is being used.

Rulebook p.56.
